title: The Door Out
text: In the dark, a door with light under it. On the other side, voices speaking your language, laughing, the clink of cups, a child's shout. It sounds like home. It is not the way you came, and none of you remember there being a door.

options.label: Open the door to the voices, and let yourselves hope it is home.

outcomes.text: A tavern, somewhere, somewhen. They feed you and send you back better than you were, and you never find the door again.
The voices stop when the door opens, all at once. Every face inside turns.

options.label: The sharpest ear knocks, and listens closely for what answers.

outcomes.text: The laughter stops. Someone on the other side whispers a warning, and it is a good one. You do not ask how they knew.

options.label: Walk on past it. Nothing down here sounds like home by chance.

outcomes.text: The laughter goes on behind you for a long time, and then it starts calling your names.
